abstract: In the present study a comparison was made between human yolk sacs and yolk sac tumors. Tubules surrounded by several to as many as 10 endodermal cells and intracellular tubules in one endodermal cell were frequently observed. The tubules were seen abundantly in the yolk sac of a 4-week pregnancy, and they resembled the reticular pattern of the yolk sac tumor. It was also observed that the papillary endoderm, which contained blood cells in the center and protruded into the endodermal tubules, resembled the Schiller-Duval body of yolk sac tumor. Ultrastructurally the tumor cells were similar to the yolk sac endoderm. alpha-Fetoprotein was positive in the yolk sac endoderm until approximately the seventh week of pregnancy. Yolk sac tumor was also alpha-fetoprotein-positive. In other words, our study of human yolk sacs of 4- to 11-week pregnancies presumes that the yolk sac tumor resembles the endoderm of 4- to 7-week pregnancies.
abstract_ja: 本研究では、ヒト卵黄嚢と卵黄嚢腫瘍の比較を行った。内胚葉細胞が数個から10個程度に囲む小管構造や、1個の内胚葉細胞内にみられる細胞内小管が頻繁に観察された。小管は妊娠4週の卵黄嚢に豊富に認められ、卵黄嚢腫瘍の網状パターンに類似していた。また、中心に血球を含み内胚葉の小管内へ突出する乳頭状内胚葉は、卵黄嚢腫瘍のSchiller-Duval小体に類似していた。超微細構造的に、腫瘍細胞は卵黄嚢内胚葉に類似していた。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は妊娠約7週目まで卵黄嚢内胚葉で陽性であった。卵黄嚢腫瘍もAFP陽性であった。すなわち、妊娠4〜11週の卵黄嚢を調べた本研究から、卵黄嚢腫瘍は妊娠4〜7週の内胚葉に類似していると推定される。
